meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 它把 Linear 接成 Claude 的消息频道：Claude 参与 issue 的评论线程，每条评论都触发它（无需 @ 提及），每个 issue 的评论线程各自成为独立会话。
howto.when: 安装并把某个 Linear 团队接好后，该团队任一 issue 出现评论时触发；Linear OAuth 应用无法被 @ 提及，因此按纯评论触发，而非提及触发。

say.text: 总结一下这个 issue 评论线程里讨论的内容
根据这条评论把方案改一版，结果回帖到线程里
say.note: 回复只出现在该 issue 的会话中

say.text: 跑一下 linear-registration 测试看看频道是否正常
say.note: 会执行该注册测试并报告结果

howto.what_en: Adds Linear as a channel through the Chat SDK bridge: Claude joins issue comment threads, every comment triggers it (no @-mention needed), and each issue thread becomes its own separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Once a Linear team is wired up, it takes over whenever a comment appears on that team's issues; Linear OAuth apps can't be @-mentioned, so plain comments trigger it.

say_en.text: Summarize what's being discussed in this issue comment thread
say_en.note: Post it in the Linear issue; Claude replies in that thread

say_en.text: Revise the plan based on this comment and post the result in the thread
say_en.note: The reply stays in that issue's conversation

say_en.text: Run the linear-registration test to check the channel
say_en.note: Runs that registration test and reports the result
